entries.evidence: Book 2, step 65 (page 3, https://www.lego.com/cdn/product-assets/product.bi.core.pdf/6013912.pdf#page=3) puts an axle 8 into a whole universal joint, both ends and the cross, and the joint onto the gearbox's output at the back, the shaft that runs to the crane base and slews the crane (function 8; the crane base is book 4, pages 43 to 48). The main model's line 349 has one end only, 62520 p706, its fork centre at 100 -60 -270, on the output axle's line (the axle 8 with stop p365, along z at x 100), and its axle hole along the shaft, holding the axle 8 p707. There is no cross and no second end, so the shaft (body 162) is joined to nothing at the gearbox, and turning the output leaves it still: function 8 is not driven at p767 94925. The file's five other universal joints each have their two ends and the cross at one point (lines 27 to 29, 40 to 42, 328 to 330, and two in submodels): 11 ends and 5 crosses in all. Added at that point: the cross 62519, and a second end 62520 reaching back along the output axle, its fork turned a quarter turn from p706's, as the file's other joints have them, in p706's colour.

With crane-shaft-universal-joint-whole: the shaft's far end is the ball driver p756 32494 in the cup p754 92906, which turns the crane base's input (the joiner p755 and the 16 tooth gear p767), put on in book 2, step 77 (page 24, https://www.lego.com/cdn/product-assets/product.bi.core.pdf/6013912.pdf#page=24). The ball's middle is the driver's origin and the socket's is the cup's, and the file has the ball 6.2 LDU short of the socket, along the shaft, so the two are not joined and the crane base is not driven (function 8, not driven at p767 94925). The file's two other balls in such cups sit at the cup's middle (axleFront.ldr lines 11002 and 11003; line 14687, 0.6 LDU off). Moved to the cup's middle, with its turn as drawn (0.2 degrees off the line from the universal joint's middle), the axle 8 p707 is 16 LDU in the driver's hole, against 10 as drawn.
